what: A hardcore kick synthesizer powerhouse (gabber, terror, speedcore) and a breakbeat chopper (Based on CHOPPAH) : a heavy kick with its own synth, DISTO and SCREAM distortion, effects and twenty memories, breaks sliced on the white keys, effects on the black keys, snare, hat, clap, songs with builds and drops, a BEGINNER mode and tutorial.
author: FLEXOR
